en.label: Portfolio
en.question:
Local results improved.
Replace the main strategy?
en.intro: 83 local paths and three standalone suites pass. Several local Sharpe metrics improve. Would you adopt this version?
en.title: The local good news did not survive the native evaluation.
en.body: The solver recorded 13.84 for the new version, against 20.53 for retained V7. It restored V7 and kept the failed experiment as evidence for the next question.
en.lesson: Progress must return to the original objective.

zh.label: 投资组合
zh.question:
本地表现更好了。
要替换主方案吗？
zh.intro: 83 条本地路径与三组独立测试通过，多个本地 Sharpe 指标也更好。轮到你决定是否采用。
zh.title: 局部的好消息，没有变成最终收益。
zh.body: 原记录报告：新版本在原生评估中得到 13.84，保留版本是 20.53。Agent 恢复了旧版本，并保留这次失败带来的线索。
zh.lesson: 进展要回到原目标上验证。

en.label: Graph
en.question:
Accuracy jumps.
Is that success?
en.intro: On two generated-graph comparisons: 41.2% → 85.0% and 61.9% → 88.2%. Is that enough to adopt the new approach?
en.title: It answered one question. Others stayed open.
en.body: The same record reports 32% more time on the independent-edge control, with accuracy unchanged there. Improvement in the native score remains unproven. A useful finding can retain its scope and uncertainty.
en.lesson: A valuable finding can still carry an unknown.
en.status: Source label: confirmed; native gain unproven

zh.label: 图分类
zh.question:
准确率大幅提高。
就算成功了吗？
zh.intro: 生成图上的两个对照：41.2% → 85.0%，61.9% → 88.2%。这足够让你为新方案按下采用吗？
zh.title: 它回答了一个问题，还没回答全部问题。
zh.body: 原记录同时报告：独立边控制组的时间成本增加 32%；原生评分是否改善尚未证明。这条发现可以保留，但适用范围要跟着它一起留下。
zh.lesson: 一个有价值的发现，可以同时带着未知。
zh.status: 来源记录：确认；原生收益未证

en.label: Ad placement
en.question:
The screening run won.
Roll out the trick?
en.intro: Give the highest-loss ads optimization priority. It sounds reasonable, and six screening seeds looked better too.
en.title: Fresh samples changed the first impression.
en.body: High-loss-first ordering won screening but lost on the pooled score of 32 fresh seeds. The solver stopped adopting that ordering, kept its current best and moved to a new hypothesis.
en.lesson: Creativity includes letting go of a beautiful idea.

zh.label: 广告优化
zh.question:
小规模筛选赢了。
要推广这个技巧吗？
zh.intro: 让损失最大的广告先获得优化机会。这个直觉很合理，六个筛选种子上的表现也更好。
zh.title: 新的一批样本，改写了第一印象。
zh.body: 原记录报告：优先处理高损失广告的排序，在筛选中获胜，却在后续 32 个新种子的合并评分中退化。Agent 停止采用这个排序，保留当前方案，转向新的假设。
zh.lesson: 创造力也包括：及时放下一个漂亮的想法。
